The structure of CaZr₂ (Ca₂Zr₄ per cell) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with six atoms and two independent Wyckoff orbits. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all six sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between 12-vertex Zr polyhedra, and corner/face sharing between Ca and Zr polyhedra.
